# AlphaSMB

> AlphaSMB is the delivery arm that installs automations, private hosted models, and company brains for startups through ~$50M — for leaders who are already using AI and want it to compound. What we build stays yours when we leave.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://alphasmb.com/): Operationalization positioning. Three doors — assess, advise, build.
- [AI Readiness Assessment](https://alphasmb.com/assessment): Free diagnostic — 15 questions across mindset, skillset, and toolset. No email required to start.
- [Services](https://alphasmb.com/services): Offer ladder — assessment, strategy call, ops audit, automations, private AI, company brain.
- [Strategy Call](https://alphasmb.com/services/strategy-call): $500 one-hour session. Playbook you can run. Live product; book at /book.
- [Operations Audit](https://alphasmb.com/services/ops-audit): Working session in live systems. Scored shortlist + three-option proposal.
- [Automations](https://alphasmb.com/services/automations): 16-item menu. Five launch pages. Founder-led custom until a delivery kit exists. No public clocks.
- [Private AI](https://alphasmb.com/services/secure-ai): Hosted model in the customer's environment — cloud-native in their tenancy, hybrid (recommended), or on-prem. Never our cloud.
- [Company brain](https://alphasmb.com/services/company-brain): Full install on inference they own. Unbranded default.
- [About Zach Henderson](https://alphasmb.com/about)
- [Book a Call](https://alphasmb.com/book): $500 via Cal.com + Stripe
- [Privacy Policy](https://alphasmb.com/privacy)

## About the Founder

Zach Henderson — Fractional Head of AI at Aurora WDC. Leads AI work inside the company. Prior: Epic Systems, healthcare IT, 20+ years real estate, industrial engineering, product companies.

## Services

AI Readiness Assessment (free): 15-question diagnostic. Instant results. Optional email report.

One-Hour Strategy Call ($500): Highest-leverage next build, playbook, shareable report.

Operations Audit: Artifact-driven session in live systems. Front door to priced automations.

Automations: Named outcome-scoped installs. Launch set: daily ops brief, invoice processing, B2B collections drafts, quote drafter, job profitability. If a native button already does the job, we don't sell the install.

Private AI: Customer-owned inference. Cloud / hybrid / on-prem. Admin Card. Cancel-and-keep.

Company brain — full install: Memory layer on inference they own. They hold root.

## Positioning

For early adopters who have already proven AI in pockets. The gap is operationalization — personal wins to systems the business runs on. Not a zero-start change-management pitch.
